responsibility: Implements the Go frontend’s `-fgo-dump-ast` debug dump by traversing the `Gogo` tree, functions, blocks, variables, statements, expressions, and types and printing a readable textual view of the frontend AST. It owns the concrete traversal logic that emits function headers, block nesting, variable preinit blocks, and per-node formatting through `Ast_dump_context`, and writes the resulting dump to `.dump.ast` files while reporting dump-file I/O errors through frontend diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Defines the concrete AST dump implementation: it registers the "ast" dump flag with the go-dump registry, walks Gogo/functions/blocks/statements to emit `.dump.ast` files, and includes debug-only type dumping helpers. Unlike ast-dump.h, this file contains the traversal and file-output logic rather than the `Ast_dump_context` interface.
